Priority P2, domain verbal_en, 15 items. Status of every item: not approved.

## Items

### 1. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0001`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Which order makes a coherent paragraph about a barangay water interruption.
P. On Friday evening, residents filled pails and drums with enough water for the day.
Q. By Saturday night, the water was back on and the tanker left.
R. During the repair, a tanker truck parked at the barangay hall for those who ran short.
S. The water district announced a twelve-hour interruption for pipe repairs on Saturday.

- (A) S-P-R-Q
- (B) Q-S-P-R
- (C) S-R-P-Q
- (D) S-P-Q-R

### 2. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0002`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Choose the best sequence for a paragraph about renewing a driver's license.
P. At the LTO office, he first passed the medical examination.
Q. He left the office with a new license valid for ten years.
R. Ramon booked an online appointment two weeks before his license expired.
S. He then paid the renewal fee at the cashier and had his photo taken.

- (A) Q-R-P-S
- (B) R-P-S-Q
- (C) R-S-P-Q
- (D) R-P-Q-S

### 3. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0003`  (both, medium, 60 s)

Q. Over one weekend, the staff relabeled and moved all the folders.
R. The supervisor proposed filing every folder by client surname instead.
S. The records unit kept losing folders because files were stored by date received.

- (A) P-S-R-Q
- (B) S-Q-R-P
- (C) S-R-Q-P

S. By the end of the quarter, attendance and attention in class had improved.

- (A) S-R-Q-P

S. That night, the municipal disaster office moved coastal families to the gym.

- (A) Q-S-R-P

- (C) Q-R-S-P

### 9. `CIVIO-GF2K05-RCD-0001`  (both, medium, 70 s)

Read the passage.
The city opened a weekend lane at its civil registry for working residents. In the first month, the lane handled about 300 requests, most of them for birth certificates. Staff noticed, however, that many applicants arrived without a valid ID and had to come back. The registry now posts the list of requirements on its social media page every Friday.

Why does the registry now post the requirements every Friday?

- (A) Many weekend applicants lacked a valid ID and had to return.
- (B) Applicants complained that the weekend lane was always empty.
- (C) The registry wanted to stop issuing birth certificates on weekends.
- (D) Every applicant in the first month came without a valid ID.

### 10. `CIVIO-GF2K05-RCD-0002`  (both, medium, 70 s)

Read the passage.
Under the new rule, government offices must act on simple transactions within three working days. A simple transaction is one that needs only a routine check of submitted documents. Requests that require a technical evaluation, such as a building permit, follow longer timelines set by each office.

According to the passage, which request follows a longer timeline?

- (A) A simple request needing only a routine document check
- (B) A building permit that needs a technical evaluation
- (C) A request filed at an office outside the city hall
- (D) Every request filed during the three-day period

### 11. `CIVIO-GF2K05-RCI-0001`  (both, medium, 70 s)

Read the passage.
Mangrove seedlings planted in the wrong zone often die within months. Seedlings placed too low on the shore are drowned by the tide twice a day, while those placed too high dry out. Groups that first study where wild mangroves already grow tend to see far more of their seedlings survive.

What can be inferred about successful mangrove planting?

- (A) Planting more seedlings guarantees success in any part of the shore.
- (B) The right planting zone is important for seedling survival.
- (C) Mangrove seedlings grow best when they are watered by hand daily.
- (D) Seedlings planted low on the shore always survive the tides.

### 12. `CIVIO-GF2K05-RCI-0002`  (both, medium, 70 s)

Read the passage.
A rural health unit began sending text reminders to mothers two days before their children's vaccination dates. Over six months, the share of children who missed a scheduled dose fell from one in four to one in ten. Nurses say some mothers still miss visits because the nearest jeepney stop is far from their homes.

Based on the passage, which statement is best supported?

- (A) Missed doses declined after reminders began, but distance still affects some visits.
- (B) The text reminders had no effect on missed vaccination doses at all.
- (C) The health unit has started a free jeepney service for mothers.
- (D) Text reminders have completely ended missed vaccination doses.

### 13. `CIVIO-GF2K05-RCM-0001`  (both, medium, 70 s)

Read the passage.
Before the new queue system, clients at the municipal treasury stood in one long line regardless of their transaction. Now a guard gives each client a numbered stub for one of three windows: payments, certifications and inquiries. Average waiting time fell from about an hour to twenty minutes, although clients with several transactions must now line up more than once.

Which statement best summarizes the passage?

- (A) The new queue system made waiting time at the treasury longer than before.
- (B) The treasury hired more guards to handle complaints about the old line.
- (C) Separate windows cut waiting time, though some clients queue more than once.
- (D) Clients now wait twenty minutes for each of their several transactions.

### 14. `CIVIO-GF2K05-RCM-0002`  (both, medium, 70 s)

Read the passage.
A fishing cooperative in Bohol began keeping a logbook of every catch: the species, its size and where it was caught. After two years, the records showed that juvenile fish were caught most often near a single reef. The members voted to stop fishing there for six months each year.

What is the main idea of the passage?

- (A) The cooperative stopped keeping records because they were not useful.
- (B) The cooperative moved its members to a new town in another province.
- (C) Catch records helped the cooperative decide how to protect young fish.
- (D) The logbook recorded only the species and size of each catch.

### 15. `CIVIO-GF2K05-RCV-0001`  (both, medium, 70 s)

Read the passage.
In the memo, the director asked division chiefs to "temper" their requests for new equipment because the budget for the coming year had been reduced. Chiefs were told to list only items needed to keep current services running.

As used in the memo, "temper" most nearly means

- (A) increase or expand greatly
- (B) harden by heating and cooling
- (C) express in an angry mood
- (D) moderate or scale down

## Answer sheet (open only after answering)

### 1. `CIVIO-GF2K05-PO-0001`: key (A) S-P-R-Q

- Why correct: Answer: "S-P-R-Q". S sets up the situation, P and R are the next steps in time order, and Q gives the result.
- (B) "Q-S-P-R" puts the closing outcome (Q) first; the paragraph must open with S.
- (C) "S-R-P-Q" swaps P and R; P has to happen before R.
- (D) "S-P-Q-R" places the outcome (Q) before the step it follows (R).
